FILED s531c (Opus agent, 2026-11-01), found attributing the Template-Toolkit table.t rows that ran once #4083's PCL half was fixed.  PRE-EXISTING (base ade297e7 identical).  SILENT WRONG.

    my $p = 1; my $n = 2; my @a = (4, 5);
    sub show { my $r = shift; print scalar(@$r), " [", join(",", map { defined $_ ? (ref $_ ? "REF" : $_) : "u" } @$r), "]\n" }
    show([ $p ? ((7) x $n) : () ]);     # perl: 2 [7,7]      PCL: 1 [REF]
    show([ $p ? ((undef) x $n) : () ]); # perl: 2 [u,u]      PCL: 1 [REF]
    show([ $p ? (@a, 6) : () ]);        # perl: 3 [4,5,6]    PCL: 2 [REF,6]
    show([ 0 ? () : ((1) x 3) ]);       # perl: 3 [1,1,1]    PCL: 1 [REF]
    show([ ($p ? ((3) x 2) : ()), 9 ]); # perl: 3 [3,3,9]    PCL: 2 [REF,9]
  Controls = perl: `[ ((7) x $n) ]`, `[ $p ? @a : () ]`, `[ $p ? (8, 9) : () ]`, `my @x = ($p ? ((7) x $n) : ())`, `[ map { ($_) x 2 } 1, 2 ]`, a sub returning the list.
Probes: scratch/s531c/p/rep1.pl rep2.pl rep3.pl in the s531c worktree.

MECHANISM: the emission is `(p-array-init (p-if $p (vector (p-list-x (vector 7) $n)) (vector)))` -- a vector holding the p-list-x VECTOR.  p-array-init's vector arm (cl/pcl-runtime.lisp ~15885) flattens its argument ONE level (`(loop for item across e do (%p-array-store-scalar result item))`), so the inner raw vector reaches %p-array-store-scalar and becomes a REFERENCE; the list assignment `my @x = (...)` is right because %p-flatten-list's walk recurses (`(loop for x across item do (add x))`).  Fix shape (rule 11): p-array-init's vector / list arms route a nested non-string vector, cons, hash table or marker back through `add-element` (the canonical flatten's recursion); a REFERENCE is a p-box, never a raw vector (%p-storable-raw keeps every is-ref value boxed), so no raw vector inside a list is a reference.  Bar: the probes, the full sweep (a `cl/` change), table.t.
ROWS: Template-Toolkit-3.106-0 table.t rows 5 and 9 ("template text 1 / 3 did not match expected": `a..b..c..d..e..ARRAY(0x4)..`) -- Template::Plugin::Table::col's `[ @$data[$start..$end], $self->{_PAD} ? ((undef) x $blanks) : () ]`.


=== DONE (s531d) ===
FIXED in cl/pcl-runtime.lisp p-array-init: the vector / list arms call a new local add-item, which sends a NESTED group (a raw non-string vector, a cons, a raw hash table, the %ENV marker) back through add-element -- the canonical flatten's recursion (%p-flatten-list-general) -- and stores anything else through %p-array-store-scalar as before.  A reference is always a p-box, so no value is re-spread; raw nil keeps its old arm.  All the filing's rows and the launch block's spellings (`[ (1, (2, (3))) ]`, `[ ((1) x 2), ((2) x 0) ]`, `[ $c ? (1, (2)) : () ]`, `%h` / `@a x 2` / empty arrays in an arm, refs inside the nested list staying one element) agree with perl 5.40.3 (scratch/s531d/p/n1.pl).
Guard: Pl/t/anon-array-flatten-01.t (2 rows; row 1 FAILS on ade297e7, row 2 = controls).  Board: Template-Toolkit table.t 21/0 in a one-file run on the tree rebased over s531c's #4083 fix -> rows 5 and 9 left cpan-board14-fails.tsv by edit (CLOSE-WITH-ROWS).
